title: Separate running work from open screens
supabiz_proposal: Phone and desktop reconnect to a durable run; cloud execution remains independent of their views.

title: Put actionable work in an attention inbox
supabiz_proposal: Show needs decision, waiting person, stale dependency and verified outcome; prioritize deadline and impact.
measure: Time to identify and resolve blockers

title: Keep seen, approved and complete distinct
supabiz_proposal: Acknowledging a notification never approves an action or closes another person’s responsibility.
measure: False closure; unread noise; approval mistakes

title: Separate agent activity from business outcome
supabiz_proposal: Idle or done is an observation; verify the stock record, assignment or provider effect independently.

title: Use scoped stable identities
supabiz_proposal: Persist business, record, run, attempt, effect and node IDs separately from pane names or device selection.

title: Keep unknown and stale states visible
supabiz_proposal: Record signal provenance and freshness; disable writes from stale views until current authority and state are checked.

title: Prefer explicit adapters; contain heuristic fallback
supabiz_proposal: Accept typed lifecycle signals when possible; isolate screen matching to compatibility adapters and regression-test it.
measure: Detection precision and recall by provider version

title: Preserve parent identity through child blockers
supabiz_proposal: A helper’s question routes to the owning workflow without replacing its identity or leaking another session.

title: Treat reconnect, restore and handoff separately
supabiz_proposal: Explain what survives; a restored conversation is not a recovered external action.

title: Persist and reconcile business effects
supabiz_proposal: Write intent before dispatch; preserve request identity and reconcile unknown outcomes before retry.

title: Supervise nodes independently
supabiz_proposal: Use heartbeat, generation checks, jitter and retry budgets; one offline node does not block healthy workers.

title: Show where work runs and what it needs
supabiz_proposal: Show cloud versus authorized device, capability dependencies, last online and permitted fallback.

title: Separate viewing from controlling
supabiz_proposal: Show controller, scope and explicit takeover; fence old writes and authorize every mutation path.

title: Use mature transport with device enrollment
supabiz_proposal: Private local IPC and trusted transport plus SupaBiz node identity, business grants and revocation.

title: Make plugin trust and capability grants explicit
supabiz_proposal: Review pinned packages; run extensions with minimal secrets, bounded resources and scoped tools.

title: Keep code, config, secrets and state separate
supabiz_proposal: Immutable packages, scoped configuration, secret broker, durable state and independent retention.
measure: Upgrade loss; secret copies; restore correctness

title: Recover UI state after event gaps
supabiz_proposal: Detect cursor gaps, refresh an authorized snapshot and keep business history in a durable ledger.

title: Send changes with version checks
supabiz_proposal: Use revisioned patches and full snapshot fallback; enforce audience permissions on both.
measure: Bandwidth; stale patch rejection; p95 render time

title: Bound and measure capacity
supabiz_proposal: Set per-tenant concurrency, budgets, queue/output limits and deadlines; measure full worker and model costs.
measure: Noisy-neighbor impact; cost per verified result

title: Start with an operator console; defer terminal complexity
supabiz_proposal: Evaluate herdr for engineering supervision; build a business UI and workflow durability before custom PTY migration.
